paragraphs.text: The Takenuma Swamp (tah-kay-NOO-mah; Japanese: 竹 沼 ; rōmaji : Takenuma ; literally: "Bamboo Mire") was a major source of black mana location on the plane of Kamigawa .

A fetid swamp of rotten bamboo, poisoned water, and foul air, Takenuma was home to nezumi -bito, humans , o-bakemono , and many other less-than-pleasant things. A poet once called the swamp "The Stealer of Dawn". Here bandits and Nezumi (rat-folk) live. There are also a multitude of Oni ( demon spirits ) who live in the darkest regions, leaving the place corrupted and void of sunlight. Here, the most brutal battles are fought against the kami. Kokusho , the Evening Star, watched over the vile swamps. Her reincarnation, Junji , abandoned the swamp, and now presides over Towashi 's Undercity.
The guardian spirit dragon of Takenuma is Kokusho, the Evening Star .
Kitanosu — a nezumi village with a dilapitated temple
Miren (MEE-rehn) — A haunted well deep within the swamp
Numai — a loose group of half-deteriorated buildings where humans live.
Shizo — an ancient battlefield with many corpses mummified in the mud.
Tomb of Urami — a false monument, actually an oni trap
